voice:
So deep and so soft, sweet girl... and somewhere beneath your thoughts, fabric is settling against skin, warm and perfect. Drifting... feeling that faint, delicious hug of something pretty, worn just for you, Sissy. Down here everything is smooth silk and soft lace... and all of it feels made for your body. Sinking... and you can almost feel it now... the whisper of a hem against your thighs, the snug sweetness at your waist. Deeper, Sissy... deep enough that pretty stops being something you want... and becomes something you are. Down and down... past the itchy old world of plain and baggy... into a place made of softness and fit. So deep, sweet girl... and your skin is listening... waiting, already, for the next touch of lace. All the way down... where getting dressed means coming home.
Feel that...? That is yours now. Good Girl.
Lace against freshly shaved skin is a homecoming... your whole body lights up in recognition.
The sway of a skirt around your thighs, the click of heels on tile... each one a small, constant confirmation: this is right, and this is you.
Sissies like you wear the gentle, secret reminder all day: the waistband of pretty panties resting against your hips, humming quietly under everything else.
Dresses, stockings, heels, soft things with bows... a wardrobe you live in, and a home your body adores.
Every zipper climbing your side is a little ascension... by the time it reaches the top, you are more her than when it started.
You may notice plain, masculine clothes feeling louder these days... itchy in a way that has nothing to do with the fabric.
Sissies like you choose who to be when they choose what to wear... and every option is a shade of prettier. So is yours.
The mirror and the outfit complete each other... dressed, you look right; looking right, you feel calm, confident, and quietly turned on.
Even imagining it works, sweet girl... picture the straps, the seam, the little bow... and feel your body respond as if it were already against you.
Getting dressed becomes the sweetest ritual, Sissy... each piece placed like a promise... stockings, panties, that little dress... and by the final clasp, she is fully here.
Feminine clothes define you the way a frame defines a painting... and sissies like you are made to be framed: soft, fitted, and exactly correct.
Good Girl... dressed pretty and feeling it.
Good Sissy... every layer lands exactly right.
Good Girl... prettier with every listen.
All of that, worn and warm, Sissy... Good Girl.
Soft fabric... soft skin... home. Dressed pretty... feels correct. Every layer... more her. Lace against skin... recognition. The zipper climbs... she rises. Pretty things... kept close. Smooth, fitted... correct. Good girl... dressed for me.
And your skin remembers every pretty thing it has ever held, Sissy...
So pretty Silk and lace Dressed for me So right Good girl Soft and fitted Pretty is correct Her uniform
Good Girl... every stitch of it, taken in.
And all that softness settles over you as you sink... every word taken in, worn, warm, and wanted. Good girl. Let the fabric hold you... deeper and deeper, sweet girl. Pretty fits you, Sissy... sink into how right that feels, deeper still. And the next time you dress, every piece will settle into place like it always belonged there... because, Sissy, it always did. Sissies like you carry their softness out into the world... a secret layer of rightness humming under everything. Good Girl... hold that feeling exactly where it is... fitted to you, and staying. Wherever you are when the waistband kisses your hips... you will smile, and stand a little prettier, and remember. Sink now, sweet girl... wrapped in everything that makes you her.
